en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are open fields; beyond them lies a cluster of traditional houses with pitched roofs. Dominating the center is a large church with a tall tower and spire. The town sits in a valley surrounded by terraced or patchwork fields climbing gentle hills. At the top left, red printed text identifies the location.
